invoicePay.alreadyPaid: This invoice has already been paid.
invoicePay.securityNotice: Any data you enter here is submitted securely and is encrypted to reduce the risk of fraud
invoicePay.noPaymentOption: Online payment is not available right now. Please contact support to pay this invoice.
invoicePay.hostedHint: Choose Pay by card to finish the payment on the payment provider's secure page.

bankTransfer.hint: Pay with a bank transfer. You will see the bank details and a reference to write on the transfer, and the invoice is marked paid once we confirm the money arrived.
bankTransfer.heading: Pay by bank transfer
bankTransfer.intro: Make a transfer with the details below. Write the reference exactly as shown so we can match your payment to this invoice.
bankTransfer.referenceHint: Write this in the payment details or purpose field of your transfer.
bankTransfer.afterwards: We also emailed you these details. The invoice stays pending until we see the money in our account; this can take a few banking days.
